questions.subject: era packaging of the four engineer-ruled workstreams
questions.decision: Two features: 109 = A(differential gate)+B(FR-006 wiring)+C(scope widening), 110 = D(YQuery/DuckLake [03])
questions.rationale_recorded: A/B/C share one invariant (measure, do not restate); D is a different subject with a different owner boundary and HIGH drift risk that must stay visible in its own risk section.

questions.subject: how the stdlib-only audit reuses 078's informed-consent override without a second mechanism
questions.decision: Extract a stdlib-only reader that BOTH codeconv.receipts and the audit consume
questions.rationale_recorded: One implementation of the adoption/override rules, no drift, audit keeps its stdlib-only property. Pure refactor of shipped 078 code, not a semantic re-open, so Q-olg15-09 is respected.

questions.subject: declaration burden for sites in newly-scoped audit regions
questions.decision: Tiered disposition. Every site declared; disposition in {owned, not-a-signal, disclosed}; only 'owned' carries conformance_check + negative_control.
questions.rationale_recorded: Nothing stays unexamined, burden is proportional to standing, and the per-disposition counts become the honest coverage statement instead of 387 placeholders.

questions.subject: what [03]'s conformance evidence is measured against, given no running PostgreSQL on OLAMNIT
questions.decision: Start the dormant Docker PG18 in D:\pgdata as ONE local node and measure the Postgres path against it
questions.rationale_recorded: A single local node is explicitly not [02]'s HOT-HOT-HOT triangle, so @ospark's boundary holds, while the Postgres half of the interface is measured rather than asserted -- which is the very defect workstream A exists to catch.
